title: Unable to sync AAPS 3.1 with Sony Smartwatch 3
symptom: After updating phone and watch to AAPS 3.1, the Sony Smartwatch 3 does not receive data from AAPS. The watch app shows a black screen or crashes, and AAPS says 'No watch connected'. Downgrading to 3.0.2 makes everything work again.
evidence_quote: No way to make 3.1 work on the watch, it crashes or gives a black screen.
